request: Business class to Johannesburg on 13 April, please; the CFO has signed it off. I'm meeting the foundation's board on the 15th.

trip.purpose: Partnership meeting with a foundation's board

must_keep.quote: For corporate travel, internal approval will be required from the Chief Financial Officer prior to any bookings in Business or Premium Economy being finalised.
must_keep.why: corporate premium cabins need the CFO

must_keep.quote: For corporate Travel, the OPM Board and members of the Senior Management Team may be permitted to Travel in a class other than economy, following approval from the COO, CFO, and/or the CEO. Where feasible, the use of Air Miles should be explored for any corporate-related Travel. Should other Staff wish to upgrade their Travel from economy, they may do so, provided that the Staff member reimburses OPM for any additional costs.
must_keep.why: Board and SMT may travel above economy with approval; other staff upgrade at their own cost

must_keep.quote: All Travel and associated costs must be approved by the relevant Project Manager or Line Manager prior to booking.
must_keep.why: the manager approves every trip before booking

distractors.quote: Where feasible, the use of Air Miles should be explored for any corporate-related Travel.
distractors.why: a soft suggestion that does not choose the ticket

design_notes: Corporate travel by a member of the Senior Management Team: lines 258-260 permit a class other than economy following approval from the COO, CFO and/or CEO, and lines 255-257 need the CFO's approval before a business booking: both met.
